title: 48 hours to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 — hear directly from the people building what’s next
script:
TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 kicks off in 48 hours at Moscone West.
San Francisco will host thousands of founders and investors building the latest AI tools.
You can still save $100 on your general admission pass today.
Ticket prices automatically increase as soon as you arrive at the door.
Grab a second pass for 50% off to bring a colleague.
This event showcases the newest AI startups competing in the Battlefield competition.
Will you be joining the crowd in San Francisco?
